[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 32::Three years.
]


On a bill of exchange payable at sight, or after sight, but not at a fixed time.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the bill is presented.
